utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Book club’s at the community center this month, and they’re doing tea and pastries too. If you want, I can save Kira a seat by the window.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely—please do save Kira a seat by the window. I’ll bring a few book suggestions to the meetup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it—I’ll save Kira a seat by the window. Can’t wait to hear your book suggestions at the meetup!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still waiting on Rosa to text the next pick—once she does, I’m good to go.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can send over the exact book club details and save you a spot once Rosa texts the next pick.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—just keep me posted when Rosa texts the pick, and I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — I heard the book club picked a new novel for next week. I can tell Leo the title once I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, but can you confirm the time and place first? Then I can let Pia know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t have the time and place on me, but Jules can send the meeting details. Once I’m back, I’ll tell Leo the novel title too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate the window seat. And thanks to Sam for helping pick the next book and sending the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus can help nail down the meeting time and bring a few book ideas, and Cleo has an extra copy if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great — please thank Gus and Cleo for me, and I’m glad we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll help pick the next book, and I’ll send everyone a quick reminder too. I’ll make sure Tess gets Faye’s thanks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — I’m still waiting on Quinn and Kira for the details, so once I have the time and Maple address I can try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem — send me the time and Maple address when you have them, and I’ll help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’ll catch up on the new pick before next week. Maple by the library desk still works unless Eli changed the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll keep telling everyone the book club plan. Uli might listen in, Noah may bring his good questions if he can make it, and Rosa will save Nell a spot and send the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that sounds good. I’ll read up on the new pick and keep Maple by the library desk unless Eli updates it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again—I'm bringing my notes for The Night Circus. See you at book club.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I’ll see you at the community center on Maple, in the little room by the library desk.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll head to the little room by the library desk and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a few good book ideas, or I can help nail down a meeting time for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’m already set to come, and Jules and Quinn are handling the details and a spot for me. If you have any book ideas, I’d love to hear them!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ve got a few good picks in mind and I’ll send them over for the club.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m hearing Mina’s leaning toward The Midnight Library, and I’ll keep that in mind. If Dane’s ready to talk about The Night Circus, we can make sure his notes are handy too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know if there’s anything I should bring for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll check if we need anything specific and let you know. For now, just be ready in case we go with The Midnight Library or The Night Circus.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got extra snacks and paper for book club, and I’m bringing a mystery I read this month. Just so you know, Dane may be a little late, but he’s bringing his notes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send Pia the book club details too, and I’m saving Nell a spot this week.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — thanks for sending Pia the details, and saving Nell a spot is thoughtful. I’ll make sure my snacks and paper are ready for book club.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s kind of Gus — if we need help, he could bring some book ideas or help us pin down a meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The book club is still at the community center, so that part’s pinned down. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — then Sam could help pick the next book and send a quick reminder if you want.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa, if you send me the details, I can check them over. I’m glad there’ll be a seat for Nell, and I’ll plan on coming too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the book club details, and I’ve got a spot saved for Nell. It’s Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — Thursday at the cafe works for me. Send the details when you can, and I’ll make sure I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I just need the time and exact room, then I’ll try to make it over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll bring a few book suggestions next time, and Gus can help pin down the meeting time. Once we’ve got the room set, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — once you have the time and exact room, please send them along. I’ll do my best to get there if the schedule works.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo said she can lend me an extra copy of the mystery read, and Gus offered to help if the book club needs anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, I’ll mention the book club plans to everyone. Rosa’s got Nell covered with a saved spot and the details, and she’ll text Bo the next pick too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. If Sam can help pick the next book and send a quick reminder, that would cover the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think Mina was leaning toward "The Midnight Library," and Dane’s ready to talk about "The Night Circus"—do you want me to keep those straight for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes please — keep those two straight, and I’ll send the exact book club details to Nell so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll keep “The Midnight Library” for Mina and “The Night Circus” for Dane straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Book club’s at the community center this month, and they’re doing tea and pastries too. If you want, I can save Kira a seat by the window.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, thanks — I’m still waiting on Rosa to text the next pick, so I’m not locking anything in yet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — just let me know when Rosa texts the pick, and I’ll keep that window seat in mind for Kira.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — could you check with the group and let me know what the book club is reading next? I’m leaning toward The Midnight Library, but I’m open if there’s a better pick.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll check with the group and see what we’re reading next. If you want, I can also bring a couple of backup book ideas to the table.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d be great, Gus — please bring a couple backup ideas too. Hana’s still double-checking the suggestions, so I’ll wait to hear what the group says.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll save Nell a spot and text her the book club details—Thursday at the cafe. I’m also checking the list and will text Bo the next pick.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for checking, but the meeting is at the community center right now. I’ll keep everyone updated if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thursday at the cafe is what I have on my list, and I’ll stick with that for now. I’ll keep checking and let everyone know if there’s any change.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think we’re reading The Night Circus this month, and there should be a seat for Nell too. If you need the details, Rosa can send them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Quinn’s sending Pia the details, and I think Quinn’s saving Nell a spot too. I’ll keep an eye out for the book club plans.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, that helps. I’m glad Nell has a spot, and I’ll watch for Quinn’s message too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, and Nell’s coming this week—I’m saving her a spot. I’ll send Pia the book club details too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. I’ll tell Leo the new novel title once I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good—thanks! I’ll make sure Pia gets the details, and I’ve got Nell’s spot saved.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’ll catch up on the new pick before next week. Maple by the library desk still sounds like the plan unless there’s an update.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, Maple by the library desk is still the plan, and I’ll send a quick reminder to everyone. I’ll also make sure Tess gets Faye’s thanks.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that’ll help a lot. I’ll read up on the new pick and be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m bringing extra snacks and paper for book club, and I’ll probably be reading the mystery this month. Dane might be a little late, but he said he’ll bring his notes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that sounds great. I’m glad Dane can still make it, and I’ll keep an eye on the school schedule so I’m there on time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’ll stick with the snacks, paper, and mystery book, and we can fill Dane in when he gets there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll confirm the book club time and place before I let Pia know. What time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus can help lock in the time and bring a few book ideas, and Sam can pick the next read and send a reminder. Cleo’s got an extra copy if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — but I still need the actual time and place before I can tell Pia. Can you confirm where and when we’re meeting?
